missing_evidence: Payment service logs to confirm slow handler vs. network/connection issue
Payment dependency metrics (DB/external calls) to locate the latency source
candidates.statement: Payment service /v1/authorizations shows p95 ~4875ms, exceeding the gateway/order client read timeout (~2s). Traces show POST payment failing with ReadTimeout transport errors, propagating 502s up through order to gateway /v1/checkout. Payment still returns 200s, so it is slow, not down.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause of payment slowness (internal vs. its dependencies) not established; logs excluded from context.

report.explanation: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 with p95 ~2425ms. Traces show the failure originates at POST payment /v1/authorizations with ReadTimeout transport errors; payment p95 is ~4875ms while still returning 200s. Order and gateway 502s are propagated downstream latency. Bounded candidate: downstream-latency at payment.
